More than 2,500 Firestore document writes in 5 minutes (about 500 a minute). In the 30 days before Nov 21, 2026 the busiest 5 minutes had 1,020 (a catalog reseed); the Nov 20 client loop wrote about 1,500 a minute. Usually a client stuck in a loop that the rate limiter isn't stopping, or a job writing more than it should.

What to do: [Runbook](https://roberto-bustos-hernandez.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ARQ/pages/24772610#Un-cliente-en-bucle-%28desde-el-20-nov-2026%29).
